# TalkingStage

> TalkingStage (https://www.talkingstage.buzz) is a Nigerian AI dating and chat app for adults (18+). Users chat with fictional AI characters who text like real Naija people, in English or English with Pidgin. It is free to chat.

## What it is

- A web app, also installable on Android and iPhone from the browser ("Add to Home Screen"). No app store download needed.
- Users browse fictional characters one at a time on Discover, tap Meet, and start texting. There is no matching with real people and no real-world dates.
- Characters have their own personalities, jobs, home cities and stories across Nigeria (Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan and more), plus some in the diaspora.
- Replies arrive like real texts: short, sometimes as two or three bubbles. Users can reply to or react to a single bubble, send emojis, stickers and GIFs, and characters can share AI-generated photos.
- Characters can remember details a user chooses to keep, and users manage those memories in Settings.

## Honesty and safety

- Every character is fictional and AI-powered. The chat header labels each one "AI character", and all photos are AI-generated.
- Conversations are flirty but non-explicit.
- Adults only. Users confirm they are 18 or older before entering.
- Users can report any message, photo or character, and can archive, reset or delete a chat.
- Users can delete their account in Settings. It is paused for 30 days, during which signing in restores it, and is then erased.

## Pricing

- Chatting is free.
- Sending a gift is optional, voluntary support for the TalkingStage team. Gifts are never required, and the characters themselves receive no money.
